caption:
A fungus doesn't have larvae.

Before picking its or their, ask who actually owns the thing. Here, the ants: their larvae.

Comment the wrong word before you check.
tiktok_caption: Who owns the larvae? The ants. Their.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Pronoun-Antecedent Agreement Error
youtube.description: Spot the error: a singular pronoun used for a plural antecedent. SAT-style practice question (original).
